description: Build the evidence matrix, GO decision table and cross-organism comparison table as provenance artifacts
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np

evidence = [
 dict(citation="PMID 18452512", type="direct assay + localization", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Recombinant Blastocystis SCS is ATP-specific and the protein is in the MRO",
      finding="ATP-specific, GTP inactive; kcat 133/min with ATP; SCS localises to the organelle matrix",
      context="Blastocystis ST1 NandII recombinant alpha/beta; immunolocalisation",
      confidence="High for specificity and location; says nothing about in vivo direction (assay run in the succinyl-CoA-forming direction)"),
 dict(citation="PMID 18757809", type="direct assay (organelle fraction)", stance="supports",
      claim="An ASCT/SCS couple operates in the Blastocystis organelle",
      finding="PNO, ASCT and succinate thiokinase activities measured in isolated MLO; incomplete Krebs cycle; hydrogenase activity not detected",
      context="Blastocystis sp. subtype 7, isolated organelle fraction",
      confidence="Medium-high; different subtype from this entry; activities measured, flux direction not measured"),
 dict(citation="PMID 18403202", type="computational + localization", stance="supports",
      claim="The organelle cannot make ATP chemiosmotically",
      finding="Complexes I and II present, no complex III, IV or F1Fo ATPase; [FeFe] hydrogenase localised to the organelle; incomplete TCA; organellar genome",
      context="Blastocystis, 12767 ESTs",
      confidence="High; EST-based absence calls are weaker than genome-based, but reproduced here on UP000078348"),
 dict(citation="PMID 12095995", type="mutant phenotype + in organello assay", stance="supports",
      claim="Organellar SCS runs ATP-forming inside an ASCT/SCS cycle",
      finding="ATP production by the ASCT/SCS cycle demonstrated directly in organello; loss of both the TCA and the ASCT/SCS cycle arrests growth, either alone does not",
      context="Trypanosoma brucei procyclic form, RNAi lines",
      confidence="High for T. brucei; transfers pathway logic, not a Blastocystis measurement"),
 dict(citation="PMID 22474284", type="mutant phenotype", stance="supports",
      claim="ASCT, not acetyl-CoA thioesterase, is the ATP-coupled acetate route",
      finding="ASCT null is ~1000-fold more oligomycin sensitive; F1-beta RNAi lethal in the ASCT null background",
      context="Trypanosoma brucei procyclic form",
      confidence="High; readout depends on an F1Fo ATP synthase that Blastocystis lacks"),
 dict(citation="PMID 32763239", type="direct assay (reconstitution)", stance="supports",
      claim="The ASCT/SCS cycle makes ATP as a coupled pair",
      finding="Reconstituted cycle is acetyl-CoA specific and has a higher kcat than yeast and bacterial ATP synthases",
      context="Trypanosoma brucei recombinant enzymes in vitro",
      confidence="High for the chemistry; in vitro"),
 dict(citation="PMID 9501211", type="direct assay (enzyme kinetics)", stance="qualifies",
      claim="ASCT needs a high organellar succinate pool",
      finding="Leishmania ASCT Km(acetyl-CoA) 0.26 mM, Km(succinate) 6.9 mM; succinyl-CoA recycled to succinate by SCS producing ATP",
      context="Leishmania mexicana promastigote, partially purified enzyme",
      confidence="High; the 6.9 mM Km sets the succinate concentration that constrains the SCS driving force"),
 dict(citation="PMID 18024431", type="direct assay + localization", stance="supports",
      claim="An acetyl-CoA hydrolase family protein is a genuine succinate-dependent ASCT",
      finding="TvASCT identified in hydrogenosomes; CoA-transferase activity is succinate-dependent; similar to yeast acetyl-CoA hydrolase",
      context="Trichomonas vaginalis hydrogenosomes, heterologous and homologous expression",
      confidence="High; defines the family that the ST1 NandII proteins belong to"),
 dict(citation="PMID 7808480", type="localization", stance="supports",
      claim="SCS is a hydrogenosomal matrix enzyme in the measured anaerobe",
      finding="alpha-SCS in purified hydrogenosomes, soluble at high pH, 9-residue cleaved presequence",
      context="Trichomonas vaginalis",
      confidence="High for location; direction asserted, not measured, in that paper"),
 dict(citation="PMID 15744302 / PMID 21378103", type="direct assay + computational", stance="qualifies",
      claim="A convergently similar organelle excretes succinate",
      finding="N. ovalis organelle uses fumarate as terminal electron acceptor and produces succinate as a major end product; metabolism stated to be remarkably similar to Blastocystis",
      context="Nyctotherus ovalis hydrogen-producing mitochondrion",
      confidence="Medium-high; succinate as a net product works against, not for, the ATP-forming direction"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt UP000078348)", type="computational", stance="supports",
      claim="The subtype of this entry encodes an ASCT partner",
      finding="A0A196SMF3 (OAO17397.1) and A0A196SNA7 (OAO17721.1), 521 aa, 58.5-59.7% identical to the T. vaginalis ASCT family, 52.8-54.3% to yeast Ach1; the only CoA-transferase family I proteins in the proteome",
      context="Blastocystis sp. ATCC 50177/NandII proteome, Smith-Waterman BLOSUM62",
      confidence="Medium-high; orthology is clear, but family members can act as acetyl-CoA hydrolases with no ATP yield"),
 dict(citation="This work (thermodynamics)", type="computational", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Direction is decided by mass action, not by the assay",
      finding="dG'o(ATP-forming) between -1.8 and -4.6 kJ/mol; at Pi 10 mM and ATP/ADP 5, net ATP needs succinyl-CoA/CoA > 0.68 at 5 mM succinate and > 1.35 at 10 mM",
      context="Standard thermodynamic calculation at 37 C, K' 2-6",
      confidence="High for the arithmetic; the organellar metabolite concentrations are unmeasured"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt UP000078348 / UP000008312)", type="computational", stance="competing",
      claim="An ATP-coupled acetate route exists that bypasses SCS",
      finding="Three ADP-forming acetyl-CoA synthetases (A0A196SMQ0, A0A196S6S6, A0A196S9Z5, 736 aa) with presequence-like N-termini indistinguishable from organelle-localised controls",
      context="Blastocystis ST1 NandII proteome",
      confidence="Medium; localisation is predicted, not measured"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt UP000078348 / UP000008312)", type="computational", stance="refutes the biosynthetic alternative",
      claim="SCS supplies succinyl-CoA for biosynthesis",
      finding="No 5-aminolevulinate synthase and no heme pathway genes at all in either genome; no lysine-to-succinyl-CoA route; methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and propionyl-CoA carboxylase present as the only remaining succinyl-CoA node",
      context="Blastocystis ST1 NandII and ST7 proteomes",
      confidence="Medium-high; absence calls on a draft WGS assembly carry residual risk"),
]
ev=pd.DataFrame(evidence)
ev.to_csv("evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print(ev[["citation","type","stance"]].to_string(index=False))

go = [
 dict(go_id="GO:0004775", term="succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity", aspect="MF",
      current_source="UniProt EXP (PMID 18452512)", recommendation="retain",
      rationale="Directly assayed with recombinant alpha/beta; ATP-specific, GTP inactive. The term names a reversible reaction and does not assert a physiological direction."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0004776", term="succinate-CoA ligase (GDP-forming) activity", aspect="MF",
      current_source="IEA TreeGrafter", recommendation="remove",
      rationale="Contradicted by direct assay: no detectable GTP activity (PMID 18452512). Classic paralog/family over-annotation by phylogenetic transfer."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0006099", term="tricarboxylic acid cycle", aspect="BP",
      current_source="IEA UniProtKB-UniRule", recommendation="remove or replace",
      rationale="The organism has no complete TCA cycle: citrate synthase, aconitase, isocitrate dehydrogenase and OGDH E1 all absent from UP000078348 and reported absent in PMID 18403202. Rule-based carry-over from mitochondrial SCS."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0006104 / GO:0006105-style succinate terms", term="succinyl-CoA metabolic process / succinate metabolic process", aspect="BP",
      current_source="none", recommendation="candidate replacement for GO:0006099",
      rationale="A direction-neutral BP term is the defensible substitute. GO:0006104 succinyl-CoA metabolic process covers the activity without committing to a direction or to the TCA cycle."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0006085", term="acetyl-CoA catabolic process / acetate biosynthetic process", aspect="BP",
      current_source="none", recommendation="do not add yet",
      rationale="Would assert the ASCT/SCS cycle. Supported by inventory and comparison but not by any Blastocystis flux or genetic evidence; the ADP-forming acetyl-CoA synthetase is an untested competing route."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0006757", term="ATP generation from ADP", aspect="BP",
      current_source="none", recommendation="do not add",
      rationale="This is exactly the directional claim the analysis cannot reach. Adding it would infer physiology from pathway context alone."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0042566", term="hydrogenosome", aspect="CC",
      current_source="UniProt EXP (PMID 18452512)", recommendation="retain, consider generalising",
      rationale="Localisation to the organelle is experimental. The organelle is explicitly described as intermediate between mitochondrion and hydrogenosome (PMID 18403202); a curator may prefer GO:0005739 mitochondrion or a mitochondrion-related organelle term."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0009361", term="succinate-CoA ligase complex (ADP-forming)", aspect="CC",
      current_source="IEA TreeGrafter", recommendation="retain",
      rationale="Heterodimer with a beta subunit is supported; the alpha subunit even forms an active enzyme with the P. falciparum beta subunit."),
]
godf=pd.DataFrame(go); godf.to_csv("go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("\n"+godf[["go_id","aspect","recommendation"]].to_string(index=False))

# comparison table across organisms
comp=[
 dict(organism="Blastocystis ST1 NandII", SCS="B3FHT4 + beta A0A196SCN8", ASCT="A0A196SMF3 / A0A196SNA7 (predicted)",
      ACD_ADP_forming="yes (3)", F1Fo="no", cplx_III_IV="no", fumarate_reduction="yes (RquA, cplx I+II)",
      heme_from_succinylCoA="no", direction_evidence="none measured"),
 dict(organism="Blastocystis ST7", SCS="D8M5V8 + D8M832", ASCT="D8M5Z7 (annotated) + 3 others",
      ACD_ADP_forming="not checked", F1Fo="no", cplx_III_IV="no", fumarate_reduction="yes",
      heme_from_succinylCoA="no", direction_evidence="ASCT and STK activities measured, direction not"),
 dict(organism="Trichomonas vaginalis", SCS="hydrogenosomal alpha/beta", ASCT="TvASCT (ACH family)",
      ACD_ADP_forming="yes", F1Fo="no", cplx_III_IV="no", fumarate_reduction="no",
      heme_from_succinylCoA="no", direction_evidence="ATP-forming, asserted from pathway + matrix localisation"),
 dict(organism="Trypanosoma brucei (procyclic)", SCS="mitochondrial", ASCT="TbASCT (family I)",
      ACD_ADP_forming="no", F1Fo="yes", cplx_III_IV="yes", fumarate_reduction="yes",
      heme_from_succinylCoA="no (heme auxotroph)", direction_evidence="ATP-forming, in organello + knockout + reconstitution"),
 dict(organism="Fasciola hepatica", SCS="mitochondrial", ASCT="C6EUD4 ASCT/PSCT",
      ACD_ADP_forming="no", F1Fo="yes", cplx_III_IV="partial", fumarate_reduction="yes",
      heme_from_succinylCoA="n/a", direction_evidence="ATP-forming, inferred from acetate+propionate output"),
 dict(organism="Nyctotherus ovalis", SCS="present", ASCT="present", ACD_ADP_forming="n/a",
      F1Fo="no", cplx_III_IV="no", fumarate_reduction="yes",
      heme_from_succinylCoA="n/a", direction_evidence="none; succinate is a major end product"),
]
cdf=pd.DataFrame(comp); cdf.to_csv("organism_comparison_table.csv",index=False)
print("\n"+cdf.to_string(index=False)[:1800])

# figure: stance tally
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.4))
order=["supports","qualifies","competing","refutes the biosynthetic alternative"]
cnt=ev.stance.value_counts().reindex(order).fillna(0)
cols=["#2a7fbf","#e8a33d","#d1495b","#4c956c"]
ax.barh(range(len(order))[::-1], cnt.values, color=cols, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels([o.replace(" the biosynthetic alternative","\nthe biosynthetic\nalternative") for o in order], fontsize=9)
for i,v in zip(range(len(order))[::-1], cnt.values): ax.text(v+0.08, i, str(int(v)), va="center", fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("number of evidence items")
ax.set_title("Evidence items by stance toward the ATP-forming direction\n(14 items: 8 primary literature, 1 comparator pair, 4 computed here)")
ax.set_xlim(0,9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
import os; print(sorted(os.listdir(".")))
